steps.label: 16-browser-forward
steps.note: Forward returns login AX, Back enabled and Forward disabled. Sampled webpage is blank; this does not prove the visual login rendered in this sample.

steps.label: 17-room-after-external-change
steps.note: User changed app before intended Back. Fresh AX/screenshot confirms Room AG206 Today30-Sep ALL. Not an Agent close/back execution.

steps.label: 18-preview-reopen
steps.note: Agent reopens Preview: Room Search and both history buttons disabled. Loading mark visible in screenshot; final page rendering not verified.

steps.label: 20-photo-previous-attempt
steps.note: Previous button click changed AX Slide 3 to Slide 1. Screenshot remains blank; exact one-step sequence/autoplay/visual identity/endpoints unknown. Earlier scroll failed noWindowsAvailable; same handle revalidated before click.

steps.note: Next button click changed AX Slide 1 to Slide 3. Screenshot remains blank; exact photo order/autoplay/endpoints not proven.
